Use body 14px, heading 36px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 8px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Set headings in Libre Baskerville and reading text in Inter; traditional serif heading with compact interface text. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
